## From Analysis to a Data Product

A data product helps someone make a decision or take action using data. In these tutorials, we will connect analytics, data storage, APIs, and an interactive interface to turn an idea into a working product.

I will guide you through this process using the **Bayesian Carousel Bandits** application as a running example. We will learn how each component works and how the components fit together.

### Learning Goals

- Identify a marketing problem and the user who needs a solution.
- Understand the analytical method and how to evaluate it.
- Build a small, usable version of the product.
- Connect data preparation, analytical logic, a database, a backend, and a frontend.
- Make the application reproducible and document how to use it.

## Start with the Product Lesson

The [Product section](content/01_problem_definition.qmd) walks through the full process: problem definition, MVP planning, prioritization, roadmaps, and implementation. It explains each diagram step by step, including [how the components connect](content/01_problem_definition.qmd#how-they-connect), [containers](content/01_problem_definition.qmd#what-is-a-container), and [Docker hosts](content/01_problem_definition.qmd#what-is-a-docker-host), before applying the ideas to the Bayesian Carousel example.

## Tutorial Guide

- [Product](content/01_problem_definition.qmd): learn MVP planning, prioritization, roadmaps, and microservices through diagrams and the Bayesian Carousel example.
- [Docker](content/02_docker.qmd): understand images, containers, and Compose through commands and expected outputs.
- [Git](content/03_git.qmd): track changes and develop features in small steps.
- [Database | PostgreSQL](content/04_database.qmd): connect ORM models to SQL, save product records, and configure the application with `.env`.
- [Frontend | Streamlit](content/05_frontend.qmd): build the user interface.
- [Backend | FastAPI](content/06_backend.qmd): understand HTTP methods and practice requests, responses, validation, and Python API calls.
- [Documentation | MkDocs](content/07_documentation.qmd): explain how to run and use the product.
